Body.Content:
What and why

Microsoft Purview is updating how legacy Microsoft Teams retention policies are applied. Some existing retention policies that are scoped to Teams currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. Beginning with this rollout, these legacy policies will be treated as Teams-only policies and will no longer implicitly apply to Copilot workloads.

Rollout schedule

  • Worldwide: Beginning in late October 2026 and expected to complete by mid-November 2026

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Organizations using Microsoft Purview retention policies that were historically configured for Microsoft Teams and currently rely on those policies to retain or delete Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions
  • Compliance administrators and records management administrators responsible for retention policy configuration

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Purview
  • Microsoft Teams
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot

What will happen

  • Legacy Teams retention policies that currently affect both Teams and Copilot data will be treated as Teams-only policies.
  • Copilot interactions will no longer be retained or deleted through these legacy Teams retention policies.
  • Retention behavior for Microsoft Teams content will remain unchanged.
  • Organizations that require retention coverage for Copilot interactions must configure retention settings specifically for the Copilot workload.

Action required and recommendations

Action is required if you currently rely on Teams retention policies to govern Copilot interactions.

  • Review existing Microsoft Purview retention policies to identify policies that may currently apply to Copilot interactions.
  • Determine whether your organization requires retention or deletion controls for Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions.
  • Configure retention policies explicitly for the Copilot workload to maintain the desired compliance coverage after this change.
  • Update internal compliance documentation and administrator guidance as needed.
  • Inform compliance and records management stakeholders of this change.

Compliance considerations

Details.Value: Legacy Microsoft Teams retention policies will no longer apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions starting late October 2026. Organizations must configure separate retention policies for Copilot data to maintain compliance, as Teams policies will only govern Teams content going forward.
